text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
SpecializeInTranslating(x, y) ::: x specializes in translating y.
InEnglish(x) ::: x is in English.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is published by y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from y.
Book(neapolitanChronicles) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book.
Book(palaceOfFlies) ::: Palace of Flies is a book.
Premises:
PublishingHouse(newVesselPress) ∧ SpecializeInTranslating(newVesselPress, foreignLiterature) ∧ ∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress) → InEnglish(x)) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English. All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
PublishedBy(neapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(palaceOfFlies, newVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
InEnglish(neapolitanChronicles) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is an English book.
